name: Global Workflow Failure Monitor
description: Global error handler: any workflow with settings.errorWorkflow pointed here sends a failure alert to Telegram chat {{TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID}} via {{TELEGRAM_MONITORING_BOT}} (credential Telegram account 2). Fires for production executions only.
_note: Exported 2026-08-11 via MCP get_workflow_details. Credentials referenced by ID only; no secrets. The n8n API strips credential refs from dumps - the credentials block on the Telegram node was re-added from known bindings.
